calibration: The 1,024 text-delta scale approximates the observed local /responses output p95 of 1,064 tokens; upstream chunk size is synthetic.
limitations: Synthetic SSE stream; no network, TLS, WebSocket framing, client processing, or model latency.
The proxy still emits one WebSocket message per SSE event.
Absolute timings depend on host load; equivalence and avoided work are deterministic.
